book.name: Ioanes
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Ioanes aime Iesu

content: Iesu la inar teuara
Urie, na natauan la o wik (sande), Maria onim Makdala la muio betieng ai una parabirat namur, tasik man arubu ka. Ga agimaieng tadas la pugutuara ra na nanam a una.
Are ratmat ga ibirieng ga ila ai Simon Petro ga non gat kulot o usingnualap, irie la mitara ume na Iesu aime, ga leilo Maria gare ro, “Maiaviara Ila Kakani na una, ga tale avet, lagum la maiabua.”
Are ratmat ga Petro ga iriro non kulot o usingnualap la oliolai pianam ga lila na una.
Man ibirliong iat ga lila, pa iriro non kulot o usingnualap la akotarekong Petro ga lake ula betong na una.
Kiraong me lourup ga ui tapma na una ga magimaong miriro burap mila murum la maialuam neip a Iesu ma. Pa tale uobu.
Simon Petro la muo malonim a ga uobu ga ula tapma na una. Ga magimaong burap la maiot.
Ga agimaong gat non buruma, irie buruma la maialu bugam a Iesu. Iriro buruma la tale kan ut ga mirie non burap. Karuk. Ui gare non migana la alukunong ga uabua ga ut na non nap.
Tie, iriro non kulot o usingnualap la betong lake ai una, irie gat la ula uobu. Ga magimaong miriro pagap ga naganong.
Na iriro tara tale ka mameit maset tiesiap la maiot na Babam aime Iesu leba ina teara na una.
Tie, inar terigiliong kulen o usingnualap me lakuan.
Maria onim Makdala la agimaieng Iesu
Urie, Maria la man dusieng lavie ai una, ga man iliba. Man iliba ka ga man kiraieng ga man ui tapma na una.
Ga legimaieng angelopien la limanim sasaip mila pasokmeng. Lionama na iriro nap tinan la maiot neip a Iesu ana. Irie la unama uala a. Pa irie la unama malakibap a.
Tie omarikliong Maria gare ro, “Magabun, memani ga man nuliba?” Pa leilo gare ro, “Maiavia ra Ila Kakani ruang, ga tale arit man nap la maiabua ana.”
Tiesieng gare tiro ga terigieng ga agimaieng Iesu la man dusong tie. Pa tale ait Maria, irie Iesu.

Urie, omarikong Iesu gare ro, “Magabun, memani ga man nuliba? Nuga aisinnang aga?” Maria la agatieng namo ga migana ra ila uale bo ubi ga ailo gare ro, “Migana ila kakani, leba naving ga nala aun, tie tonalava a nap la nuabua, meba tala taving.”
Pa ugama Iesu, “Maria”, pa terigieng Maria me ira Iesu ga tiesieng gare ro o ties Ebaraio, “Raboni”, iriro dadema “Raboni” la are ro, “Migana o usingnualap” o ties onim lakuan buong.
Pa oulo Iesu gare ro, “Baraba tonuat, memani, tale ka tula nakap ai Mamo ruang. Pa nala mai papap tuam ga manalava gare ro, ‘Eba tala nakap ai Mamo ruang ga Mamo ming, Morowa ruang ga Morowa ming.’”
Are ratmat ga Maria onim Makdala la ila, ga mailo lop o usingnualap gare ro, “Agimarung ara Ila Kakani.” Ga mailo o uriro ties la ualo Ila Kani un.
Lop o usingnualap la agimameng Iesu

Urie, lop o usingnualap la merau me Iudaiap, are ratmat ga maiolua tabuna a irie luguan la man maionama ana. Pa naminila ra muabari na urie sande. Ga muo dusong Iesu kabirana ma. Ga maulo, “Malina le ot miun.”
Tiesong gare tiro ga masinguala lie kilalapien a ga binbap a. Lop o usingnualap la agimameng Ila Kakani ga temeba dalap ma.
Tie inagat maulo Iesu, “Malina le ot miun. Mamo la tosagaong ga muruo, ga aret tiro la misagarung ga mila.”
Tiesong gare tiro ga ofuoong ifif a me maun, ga maulo gare ro, “Miarara Muranama Ila Babai.
Leba miavaiang kirinim maiong teip ga magaulap, tie eba karuk ba ume kirinim maiong; Pa leba tale miavaiang kirinim maiong inamaniap, tie kirinim maiong la eba ka man iot.”
Tomas la agimaong Iesu
Urie, tara la betong Iesu mai lop o usingnualap, non ma 12 ma lop o usingnualap la tale unama ga mirie. Irie Tomas, meiva Didimas, muana o uriro bonim kasanganipien.

Are ratmat ga non lop o usingnualap la amelo gare ro, “Agimapang ara Ila Kakani.” Pa maulo Tomas gare ro, “Leba tale agimarang kaguma o tainam la maiabu na kilan a, ga leba tale tabung kaneunam tuo me na kaguma o tainam, ga tabung kilan tuo ira ma binbap a, tie tala kan nagantung. Karuk kan migat!”

Lama 7 la malonim lop o usingnualap la man maionama gat tapma na luguan, ga Tomas gat la unama ga mirie ga mangingitmeng ara mirier tabup ganam, pa muo Iesu ga dusong kabirana ma. Ga ugama, “Malina le ot miun!”
Tie aulo Tomas gare ro, “Nabung kaneunam nung togo, ga legimanang kilalapien tuo. Ga nabung kilan nuo me ro na binbap tuo. Buat ogueknung nagan, pa nagannang it!”
Upulo Tomas ties ang Iesu ga ugama, “Nunuo Ila Kakani ruang. Nunuo Morowa ruang.”
Pa aulo Iesu gare ro, “Togimanung ara are ratmat ga nagannung, a? Teip ga magaulap la tale togimameng pa naganmeng it, miriro inamaniap la eba omela laminais.”
Iesu la makosarong papot ma non kagup onim na panbinim na irap ma lop o usingnualap, pa tale mamirtung miriro ganam na uriro babam.
Pa miriro la mamirtung, mamirtung meba naganming ira Iesu irie Karisito, Poi ang Morowa. Pa leba naganming, tie eba omila ninimiap ula iot maset atatan makin iro bonim a.
